title: Comments are anchored to lines in diffs
description: How review comments work across the three diff views.
body: A comment is a note anchored to a line range of one file in one of three diffs: unstaged, staged, or branch. Line numbers are 1-based and inclusive at both ends, naming the modified side. A single-line note has start_line == end_line. The note carries no author and no thread — two parties and a diff — so the frontend can hand it to an agent as work.
